item.title: Medical & Life Sciences
item.description:
Medical & Life Sciences  

We provide comprehensive international trade and business docking services for pharmaceutical-related products:

  1. Import & Export Support: Covering pharmaceutical raw materials (APIs), preparations, medical consumables, and pharmaceutical packaging materials.
  2. Technical & Compliance Services: Pharmaceutical technology consulting, technology transfer, and compliance path assistance.
  3. Market Expansion: Cross-border cooperation and market expansion for health industry-related projects.

item.title: Industrial Manufacturing
item.description:
Industrial Manufacturing & Advanced Equipment  

We specialize in the international trade of industrial manufacturing equipment and systems:

  1. High-end Manufacturing Products: Robots, automation equipment, and drones.
  2. Technical Services: Industrial technology services, technical consulting, and cross-border project docking.
  3. Supply Chain Integration: Import/export agency and supply chain integration for industrial products and technologies.
